summary: Aya Gold & Silver filed a 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a term sheet with Sama Resources (TSXV: SME) to sell its Moroccan Azegour copper-tungsten-molybdenum project. Consideration is payable entirely in Sama common shares representing up to 19.11% of Sama's post-issuance shares outstanding; no cash price or premium disclosed. Sama would acquire a newly incorporated Aya subsidiary holding two mining licenses and two exploration permits, plus an IP license and one year of transitional support. Closing requires a definitive agreement and regulatory approvals; no advisor or board recommendation named. Watch definitive-agreement execution, regulatory timing, and post-close stake overhang.
